claims.text: Role in HTN: a thiazide (preferably thiazide-like: chlorthalidone or indapamide) = an initial-tx class;
claims.quote: Thiazide diuretic (preferably a thiazide-like diuretic such as chlorthalidone or indapamide)

claims.text: chlorthalidone and indapamide are preferred over HCTZ (higher potency, longer action).
claims.quote: Chlorthalidone and indapamide, thiazide-like diuretics, are preferred over hydrochlorothiazide because of their higher potency (1) and longer duration of action.

claims.text: Metolazone + furosemide (or other loops): unusually lrg or prolonged fluid and lyte losses;
claims.quote: Furosemide and probably other loop diuretics given concomitantly with metolazone can cause unusually large or prolonged losses of fluid and electrolytes
